static_adapter_definition: Freeze the foundation and optimize one shared replay block on calibration episodes only. The block is identical for every episode and receives no noisy observation, episodic value, key-specific parameter, target, or test label. At inference it is prepended at the same relative layer, with the same token count, hidden width, frozen suffix, candidate head, and mixture gate as dynamic ASCENT replay.
same_flop_boundary: The registered inference-FLOP claim covers the replay_from_hidden frozen suffix and candidate projection. Training cost, dynamic memory decoding, persistent bytes, and transient activations are reported separately and are not called equal.
development_gate: At both endpoints, the paired 95% lower confidence bound of rich dynamic ASCENT fused NLL improvement over the calibration-trained static adapter must be positive. The rich dynamic foundation-by-scale gain interaction must remain positive. Exact replay-token-count, injection-layer, frozen-suffix, clean-commit, model-hash, label, signal, and query-input gates must pass.
confirmation_rule: If development passes, freeze three new untouched seeds, training steps, learning rate, prompts, endpoints, and analysis before accessing any confirmation score.
interpretation: Direct same-inference-FLOP static-adapter control for the ASCENT latent replay mechanism. FPVM excluded.
